scope: Read-only final review of the frozen correction display, review strategy, grouped conflict diagnostics and merge-failure lifecycle. No test, renderer, validator, backend, replay, model or Skill was executed for this audit.
checks: The codec recognizes the JSON boundary with raw_decode and requires the exact following complete-source marker, so literal source markers do not become boundaries.
Original logical input keys are retained; a reserved correction key, unrecognized layout or inconsistent fallback shape keeps the complete existing fallback.
The complete previous candidate or selected records plus all displayed diagnostics/format examples occupy the added correction subtree. Source suffix and instruction/schema prefix are retained.

Inventory and correction record tables preserve order, keys, absent-versus-null fields and marker-shaped literal objects; exact serialized expansion is checked before use. The shorter complete fallback or joint presentation is selected.

Grouped conflict diagnostics retain each explicit obligation/record-to-finding relationship and target IDs; raw diagnostic prose and mappings remain in immutable validation provenance rather than being duplicated in the prompt.

Source-input/cross-record review errors use the existing bounded whole-response correction; other review errors can retain existing-record replacement. Non-review stage grammars/strategy identities are unchanged.
The full-review merge guard requires outcome=completed, exactly the four arrays, and no extra keys. It rejects replacement/partial envelopes before overwriting the prior candidate.

A valid full envelope with malformed inner records becomes the terminal candidate and undergoes strict validation/isolation. A merge failure retains and records the prior full candidate while preserving the rejected response and diagnostics.
No additional call, worker, retry budget, cap increase, source truncation or contract omission was introduced by this presentation/strategy path.

The shared ResponseChain implementation is byte-identical to the accepted baseline. The new review envelope guard invokes its existing prior-candidate retention; no new common merge-failure lifecycle change occurred.
sizing_evidence: The separate frozen sizing audit reports a001=1014657 codepoints, a002=1014077, complete source/input/candidate/context equality, and all 307 conflict relationships in six groups. This static review did not rerun that measurement.
limits: No new full-acceptance verdict is made while root final scoped regression is pending.
Strict envelope and lossless delivery do not prove semantic preservation of prior allegations; the same source review and exact inventory validators remain necessary.
Finite input limits still apply to future irreducibly large complete material.
audit_correction: An initial note incorrectly described shared merge-failure retention as a new change. Direct byte comparison with the frozen baseline confirmed it was existing behavior; that attribution is corrected here.
